comment: The one source of truth for live values and tap actions (ADR-027). Validators, AI schema, prompt, Use another AI, editor pickers, auto-wire and the capability table are all built from this file. support: native | shortcut (iOS, runs a Shortcut) | panel (Android, opens a system panel) | unsupported. Adding a capability = add it here and implement its provider or action; CapabilityDriftTests / CapabilityCatalogTest fail until both are done.
